	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 1 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 2 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 3 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { exists = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author = { is_alive = yes } NOT = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author = this } }
		if = { limit = { has_relation_rival = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author } add = kehillah_review_stance_rival }
		else_if = { limit = { has_relation_friend = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author } add = kehillah_review_stance_friend }
		if = { limit = { opinion = { target = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author value >= 40 } } add = kehillah_review_stance_likes_author }
		else_if = { limit = { opinion = { target = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_author value <= -40 } } add = kehillah_review_stance_dislikes_author }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = zealous } multiply = kehillah_review_stance_zealous_mult }
	min = -100
	max = 100
}
kehillah_review_stance_work_rashi_talmud_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_talmud_torah status = core } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_core }
	else_if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_talmud_torah status = permitted } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_permitted }
	else_if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_talmud_torah status = prohibited } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_prohibited }
	if = { limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_talmud_torah } add = kehillah_review_stance_personal }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_leaning_tenet_talmud_torah } add = kehillah_review_stance_leaning }
	if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_talmud_torah)" > 10 } add = kehillah_review_stance_fits_well }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_talmud_torah)" > 0 } add = kehillah_review_stance_fits }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_talmud_torah)" < -10 } add = kehillah_review_stance_clashes_badly }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_talmud_torah)" < 0 } add = kehillah_review_stance_clashes }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 1 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 2 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 3 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { exists = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author = { is_alive = yes } NOT = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author = this } }
		if = { limit = { has_relation_rival = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author } add = kehillah_review_stance_rival }
		else_if = { limit = { has_relation_friend = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author } add = kehillah_review_stance_friend }
		if = { limit = { opinion = { target = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author value >= 40 } } add = kehillah_review_stance_likes_author }
		else_if = { limit = { opinion = { target = global_var:kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_author value <= -40 } } add = kehillah_review_stance_dislikes_author }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_trait = zealous } multiply = kehillah_review_stance_zealous_mult }
	min = -100
	max = 100
}

	if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_esotericism status = core } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_core }
	else_if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_esotericism status = permitted } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_permitted }
	else_if = { limit = { rite ?= { has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_esotericism status = prohibited } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_prohibited }
	if = { limit = { has_personal_tenet = tenet_esotericism } add = kehillah_review_stance_personal }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_leaning_tenet_esotericism } add = kehillah_review_stance_leaning }
	if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_esotericism)" > 10 } add = kehillah_review_stance_fits_well }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_esotericism)" > 0 } add = kehillah_review_stance_fits }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_esotericism)" < -10 } add = kehillah_review_stance_clashes_badly }
	else_if = { limit = { "expected_tenet_fulfillment_change(tenet:tenet_esotericism)" < 0 } add = kehillah_review_stance_clashes }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 1 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 2 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { faith = { faith_hostility_level = { target = faith:rabbinic_faith value >= 3 } } } add = kehillah_review_stance_hostile_faith }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = zealous } multiply = kehillah_review_stance_zealous_mult }
	min = -100
	max = 100
}
